text:
Rowan (CEO): Quick weekly compact — four short bullets and two asks. Please skim and ack if you own any item. TL;DR: Private Beta GA target in ~3 weeks; privacy telemetry change next Tue; incident last night (short readout below); temporary cost guardrails for new Dedicated bursts. Owners: ack and follow-up.

Rowan (CEO): 1) GA target — shipping plan attached to the release channel. We need final test signoffs from Product + SRE by end of next week. If you can't meet that, call it out now.

Maya (VP Product): Ack. I'll share the final checklist and test matrix by EOD. Need Security + Legal to review privacy copy before we publish.

Elena (Head of Security): Noted. I've opened a draft PR for the privacy text and pinged Legal. Recommend we hold telemetry opt-in change for EU until compliance confirms. Propose Wed 11:00 PT sync.

Ilya (SRE): Incident summary (last night): brief root cause = nginx routing change that caused KV cache thrash on a subset of hosts -> p95 token latencies spiked ~12m, error rate bumped for some customers. Mitigation: reverted the proxy change, tightened upstream timeouts, added a short-term rate limit. Full runbook: https://redwood.example.com/runbook/INC-2026-42

Ilya (SRE): Commands used: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/model-proxy --to-revision=6` and `sudo tc qdisc del dev eth0 ingress` (for the short-term shaping).

deploy-bot: rollback completed at 2026-03-22T03:12:18Z. Incident ticket INC-2026-42 created. Notified oncall.

Nina (Head of CS): Heads up — two early adopters (AcmeCorp, LexiApps) DM'd support about latency last night. Ilya / Marco, can we get a short customer-facing note? I'll coordinate replies.

Marco (Head of Eng): Re: cost guardrails — we pushed a soft cap on new Dedicated GPU bursts (temporary throttle) to avoid runaway spend. Patch to autoscaler with `--cost-safety` flag lands tonight; we'll monitor metrics.

Rowan (CEO): Two asks: 1) Owners please ack in-thread with short ETA on follow-ups (Product, SRE, Security, CS). 2) Product/Eng/Security: join the GA & privacy review tomorrow 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent). I'll do a 3-min all-hands update Friday to summarize.

Maya (VP Product): Ack — checklist by 18:00 PT today.

Elena (Head of Security): Ack for Wed 11:00 PT review, and delaying EU telemetry change until Legal confirms.

Ilya (SRE): Ack. I'll post a concise postmortem draft by EOD and a short customer note for Nina to use.

Nina (Head of CS): Ack — will prep comms templates and flag VIP customers to prioritize.

Rowan (CEO): Thanks all. If anything blocks your ack, escalate in thread or DM me. :thumbsup:
